guidance: Integrate a genuinely periodic field before re-tuning amplitude or claiming seam closure.

Do not use a zero post-clamp median periodic difference as evidence of periodicity; p95 and maximum defects remain nonzero.
Pre-register acceptable clipping and distribution-preservation thresholds before browser or human visual acceptance.
